tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. White like the tablecloths by day; the black of the sign in the dark theme.

tokens.name: bg-lino
tokens.usage: Paper panels: menu cards, form fields, the text side of a split. Never a whole page.

tokens.name: nero
tokens.usage: The black of the arched sign. Full-width bands (hours, contact, footer) and the logo ground. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on `bg` and `bg-lino`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Dish descriptions, captions, secondary lines on `bg` and `bg-lino`.

tokens.name: on-nero
tokens.usage: Text on `nero` bands and over dark photos.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between menu items and sections. Never for controls.

tokens.name: rosso
tokens.usage: Wine red. Full-bleed hero and poster bands, giant headline type, the primary button, the red block behind one photo. Used boldly, not as a trace.

tokens.name: bordeaux
tokens.usage: Deep wine. Full-bleed poster bands (like the Lolo reference), the menu page ground, the footer. Text on it is `on-nero`; giant type on it is `rosso` or `oro-on-nero`.

tokens.name: rosso-text
tokens.usage: Red text and links on `bg` and `bg-lino`: prices, the accent word, hover states.

tokens.name: on-rosso
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `rosso` fill.

tokens.name: oro
tokens.usage: Champagne gold for the ring, its dot and hairline rules only. Decorative: on white it is 2.6:1, so never use it for text or for anything that must be read on `bg`.

tokens.name: oro-text
tokens.usage: Gold text: eyebrows and small labels on `bg` and `bg-lino`. Body copy is never gold.

tokens.name: oro-on-nero
tokens.usage: Gold text, rules and the ring on `nero` bands (9:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 3px offset, on every interactive element.

styles.name: display-poster
styles.usage: Giant type that sits behind or around a plate photo, edge to edge (hero, poster bands). Uppercase. clamp(96px, 19vw, 280px). One per page.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Page titles, uppercase, often in `rosso`. clamp(64px, 10vw, 140px).

styles.name: script-accent
styles.usage: ONE script word or short phrase per page, overlapping a headline or photo edge, in `oro` on dark or `rosso-text` on white (Seppe, Little Italy). Never sentences, menus or buttons. clamp(40px, 6vw, 88px).

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above headlines and in poster corners.

styles.name: lede
styles.usage: One or two intro sentences. Max 40 characters wide.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pasta fresca fatta in casa e tartufo grattugiato al momento.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Pane croccante, pomodorini, cetrioli e basilico

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Eyebrow to headline; name to description in a menu item.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside buttons (vertical), between menu items, mobile side gutter.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Headline to lede; between buttons; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Lede to buttons or content; desktop gutter between columns.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile; desktop side gutter.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop. Clamp it down so each section still fits one screen.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Photos, bands, buttons, cards. The brand is square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Form fields and tabs only.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: The plate photo inside the ring, the ring's dot, and round plate cut-outs.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Rules, dividers and the ring stroke.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Fixed header height. Sections fit calc(100svh - header-h); anchors use it as scroll-margin-top.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of running text.
